verdict.rationale: Gazebo is fundamentally a robot/environment simulator that lets users test robots, sensors, and physics in a virtual sandbox instead of on real (production) hardware — it can run headless or on remote servers via TCP/IP transport, and supports numerous pre-built simulation models via Gazebo Fuel, letting an AI-native user iterate safely without touching production systems. Missing for 10: explicit framing around isolating from 'production data' (e.g., data provenance, reset/snapshot guarantees) and no first-party mention of AI/agent-specific sandbox workflows.
